title: Best Card Grading Service (2026)
verdict: AGS is the best card grading service in 2026 if you judge a service by what comes back: a decimal grade, eight subgrades, a 3D heightmap and a sealed slab, in 20 business days or less, for $18.

Who else is worth a look: PSA for maximum resale, CGC for the lowest price from a large grader, TAG for a defect report on modern cards, SGC for vintage. Each is described below from its own published terms.

sections.h: What you get for the fee
list: A grade from 1 to 10 with decimal precision.
Eight subgrades: centering, corners, edges and surface, front and back.
A 3D heightmap of the surface, color-coded from green to red.
High-resolution images and centering data for both sides.
A sealed PMMA slab with the cert number on the label.

why: The grade comes from a machine, so it does not depend on who is on shift. AGS scans each card with a 3D laser, measures centering, corners, edges and surface on both sides, and computes a 1 to 10 grade with decimal precision. Scan it again and AGS says the number holds.
You can send one card. AGS has no minimum and no membership fee, takes payment only when the cards are graded, and lets you cancel before grading starts. Bulk pricing begins at 30 cards.
AGS is past the experiment stage. Founded in 2021, it says it was third in TCG grading volume in 2026. Its population report is live and counts every card it has graded.

faq.q: What is the best card grading service?
faq.a: For most cards, AGS: measured by laser, $18 flat, back in 20 business days or less. For a card worth thousands that you plan to sell, compare PSA.

faq.q: Does AGS have a population report?
faq.a: Yes. It is real-time and includes every card AGS has graded.

faq.q: How does AI card grading work?
faq.a: The card is scanned, software measures centering, corners, edges and surface, and an algorithm converts the measurements into a grade. AGS uses a 3D laser scan of roughly 30 million data points per card. No human opinion sets the number.

faq.q: How long does card grading take?
faq.a: It depends on the grader and the tier. AGS lists 20 business days or less, with 10 and 5 day tiers. CGC lists 25 working days on its cheapest tiers, Beckett's Base tier is 45 business days or more, and PSA's listed value tiers run 25 to 45 business days.

faq.q: Can I cross a card over from another grader's slab?
faq.a: CGC and Ace Grading list crossover services. AGS's FAQ does not list one, so ask AGS before sending a card in another company's holder.
